items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: Willie Bryant was supposed to be my sweetheart in the show

ctx.x: Willie Bryant was supposed to be my sweetheart in the show, and, oh, man, oh, man, I used to beat him up something terrible in the show. What was his name? It's a shame. You know, I had to act real, you know, so I used to whip that old man.
